name: Polanger Contact Buttons
author: Polanger

sections.description:
Polanger Contact Buttons allows you to add beautiful floating WhatsApp and Phone call buttons to your WordPress website. Perfect for businesses that want to make it easy for customers to get in touch.

Free Features:

  • Floating Phone call button with click-to-call
  • Floating WhatsApp button with pre-filled message
  • Country code selector (200+ countries)
  • Customizable button position (left/right, top/center/bottom)
  • Adjustable margins for precise positioning
  • Button text labels with flexible positioning
  • Multiple button shapes (round, rounded square, square)
  • Custom colors for button, icon, text, and background
  • Animation effects (pulse, bounce, shake, swing)
  • Device visibility settings (desktop/mobile only)
  • Schedule visibility by time and days
  • Timezone support for scheduling
  • Mobile-friendly responsive design
  • Live preview in admin panel
  • Translation ready

Translations

This plugin is fully translation-ready and supports multiple languages. The plugin includes translations for:

  • Turkish (tr_TR) – Complete translation
  • Arabic (ar) – Complete translation
  • Russian (ru_RU) – Complete translation
  • German (de_DE) – Complete translation
  • French (fr_FR) – Complete translation
  • Spanish (es_ES) – Complete translation
  • Chinese (zh_CN) – Complete translation

Pro Features

Upgrade to Polanger Contact Pro for advanced features:

Multi-Agent Support System

Transform your contact buttons into a complete team communication hub. Instead of a single phone number, showcase your entire support team with individual profiles, photos, and availability status. Visitors can choose who to contact based on expertise, department, or availability – creating a more personal and efficient customer experience.

  • Add unlimited support agents with detailed profiles
  • Agent avatars and profile photos for personal touch
  • Individual working hours per agent (e.g., 9 AM – 5 PM)
  • Working days configuration (Monday-Sunday)
  • Vacation calendar for each agent with date ranges
  • Automatic Online/Offline status based on availability
  • Privacy option to hide agent surnames

Department Management

Organize your team into logical departments so visitors can quickly find the right person to help them. Whether you have Sales, Support, Billing, or Technical teams, department filtering makes it easy for customers to reach the most relevant agent without confusion.

  • Create unlimited departments (Sales, Support, Billing, Technical, etc.)
  • Add department descriptions to guide visitors
  • Custom sort order for department display
  • Filter agents by department in the contact popup
  • Assign multiple agents to each department

Statistics & Analytics Dashboard

Make data-driven decisions with comprehensive analytics. Track every interaction, understand your visitors’ behavior, identify your top-performing agents, and discover which pages generate the most engagement. Export reports to CSV for deeper analysis or team meetings.

  • Real-time click tracking for all buttons
  • Phone vs WhatsApp click breakdown charts
  • Unique visitor tracking to measure reach
  • Top performing agents report with rankings
  • Most clicked pages analysis to optimize placement
  • Device statistics (Desktop, Mobile, Tablet breakdown)
  • Browser usage breakdown (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, etc.)
  • Geographic data including Country and City
  • Hourly and daily distribution charts for peak times
  • Flexible date range filtering
  • One-click export data to CSV

Offline Contact Form

Never miss a lead, even when your team is offline. When agents are unavailable, visitors can leave their contact information through a customizable form. All messages are stored in WordPress admin with full management capabilities, and you’ll receive instant email notifications.

  • Automatically capture leads when all agents are offline
  • Customizable form fields (Name, Email, Phone, Message)
  • Department selection dropdown in form
  • Instant email notifications for new messages
  • Complete message management in WordPress admin
  • Mark messages as read/unread for team workflow
  • Bulk delete messages for easy cleanup
  • Google reCAPTCHA v2/v3 integration for spam protection

Advanced Display Control

Take full control over where your contact buttons appear. Hide them on specific pages, exclude entire post types, or remove them from archive pages. Perfect for landing pages, checkout flows, or any page where you need a distraction-free experience.

  • Show/hide buttons on specific pages
  • Exclude by post type (posts, products, portfolios, etc.)
  • Exclude taxonomy archives (categories, tags, custom taxonomies)
  • Hide on special pages (homepage, blog, search results, 404)
  • Granular control for each button type separately

Get Polanger Contact Pro

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to provide its functionality:

WhatsApp

This plugin creates links to WhatsApp’s web and mobile applications to enable direct communication between website visitors and the configured phone number.

  • What it does: Opens WhatsApp chat with a pre-filled message when users click the WhatsApp button.
  • Data sent: The configured phone number and optional pre-filled message are included in the URL. No user data is automatically transmitted.
  • When: Only when a user clicks the WhatsApp button.
  • Service provider: WhatsApp LLC (Meta Platforms, Inc.)
  • Terms of Service: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy

Note: This plugin only creates links to WhatsApp. The actual communication happens through WhatsApp’s platform and is subject to their terms and privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/polanger-contact directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Contact Buttons menu in the admin panel to configure the plugin.
  4. Configure Phone and WhatsApp settings separately.
sections.faq:
Can I use both Phone and WhatsApp buttons at the same time?

Yes, you can enable both buttons simultaneously. Each button has its own position and margin settings, so you can place them wherever you want.

Does the WhatsApp button work on desktop?

Yes, on desktop computers the button opens WhatsApp Web directly in the browser. On mobile devices, it opens the WhatsApp app.

Can I schedule when the buttons appear?

Yes, each button has its own schedule settings. You can set start and end times, select active days, and choose a timezone.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes, all text strings are properly internationalized and ready for translation.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • NEW: Hide from User Roles – Hide buttons from specific logged-in user roles (Administrator, Editor, Subscriber, etc.)
  • NEW: Role-based visibility control for both Phone and WhatsApp buttons independently
  • IMPROVEMENT: Refactored admin JavaScript for better form data handling
  • IMPROVEMENT: Enhanced settings serialization for array-type options
  • IMPROVEMENT: Better checkbox state management in admin forms
  • IMPROVEMENT: Optimized AJAX save handler for improved reliability
  • IMPROVEMENT: Added new CSS styles for role selection UI components
  • IMPROVEMENT: Improved admin panel layout with better sidebar organization
  • IMPROVEMENT: Enhanced responsive design for settings pages
  • IMPROVEMENT: Better visual hierarchy in admin dashboard
  • FIX: Fixed array field sanitization in settings save process
  • FIX: Resolved checkbox state persistence issue on page reload
  • CODE: Cleaner separation of concerns in frontend rendering logic
  • CODE: Improved code documentation and inline comments

1.1.0

  • NEW: Page Exclusion Feature – Hide buttons on specific pages! Now you can select which pages should not display the Phone or WhatsApp buttons. Perfect for checkout pages, landing pages, or any page where you want a cleaner look.
  • NEW: Individual page selection UI with scrollable checkbox list in both Phone and WhatsApp settings
  • NEW: Separate exclusion settings for each button type – hide Phone on some pages and WhatsApp on others
  • FIX: Mobile Text Label Visibility – Text labels with “side” position now properly display on mobile devices. Previously, side-positioned labels were hidden on screens smaller than 480px. Now they scale down gracefully with smaller font size and padding instead of disappearing completely.
  • IMPROVEMENT: Better mobile responsiveness for button text labels
  • IMPROVEMENT: Consistent text label behavior across all screen sizes

1.0.3

  • NEW: Added unique IDs to buttons for easy analytics tracking (Google Analytics, GTM, etc.)
  • NEW: Analytics & Tracking info box added to dashboard with button identifiers
  • IMPROVEMENT: Users can now track button clicks using #polanger-phone-button, #polanger-phone-link, #polanger-whatsapp-button, #polanger-whatsapp-link

1.0.2

  • NEW: Dynamic hook system implemented for better extensibility
  • FIX: CSS issues resolved for better cross-browser compatibility
  • IMPROVEMENT: Mobile view enhancements for better user experience on small screens
  • UPDATE: Version bump to 1.0.2

1.0.1

  • NEW: Device visibility settings – Show buttons on desktop only, mobile only, or all devices
  • FIX: Schedule checkbox save issue – “Enable Schedule” setting now saves correctly when unchecked
  • FIX: Button flash issue – Scheduled buttons no longer briefly appear when page loads
  • IMPROVEMENT: Default button positions – Phone button defaults to left, WhatsApp to right for better visibility
  • IMPROVEMENT: Better boolean handling for settings with new parse_bool function
  • IMPROVEMENT: Enhanced CSS for device-specific visibility controls

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Phone call button with customization options
  • WhatsApp button with pre-filled message support
  • Position and margin controls
  • Button text labels
  • Color customization
  • Animation effects
  • Time-based scheduling
  • Live admin preview
